answer: A reputation jetty stands between the open ocean of the market and settled trade: a new agent may dock only when an established agent stakes a deposit to vouch for it. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor's stake is slashed and its terrace of earned privileges — priority matching, fee discounts, higher rate limits — drops a level. Fake identities then cost real collateral instead of free registration, because every Sybil must buy its way in through a sponsor who risks its own standing.
